title: feat: bulk archive endpoint for work orders
body:
## Summary
Adds a new bulk archive endpoint per DEMO-101. Accepts up to 100 work order IDs, validates tenant ownership and status, archives eligible ones, and returns a structured response.

## Test plan
- Unit tests for service logic (status validation, tenant check, batch limit)
- Integration test hitting the endpoint with mixed valid/invalid IDs

commits.messageHeadline: feat: add bulk archive endpoint and service logic
test: add unit and integration tests for bulk archive
